findings.description: Background thread wakes every 5s even when no city is loaded. Add an isLevelLoaded flag and pause monitoring between OnLevelUnloading and OnLevelLoaded.
Hardcoded to 139 without checking game constants. Verify against NetInfo.SpeedToKmh conversion or expose as a configuration parameter with the spec's stated default.

vehicle.SetTargetPos(0, newPos) doesn't exist in Cities: Skylines Vehicle struct. Replace with direct position manipulation via vehicle.m_targetPos0 = newPos or remove Level 2 entirely and rely on Level 1 and Level 3.

Full buffer scan (up to 262144 entries) on level load with no yielding. Split into chunks with yield return null or move to a background job, or reduce scan frequency to only check paths for vehicles currently in the stuck recovery dictionary.

findings.issue: VehiclePoolMonitor false positive in small cities
findings.description: 10 consecutive static counts triggers throttling repair even when count is legitimately stable. Add a minimum count threshold (e.g., 100 vehicles) before applying the static-count heuristic.
Console commands (mnc.status, etc.) are defined but never registered with the game's debug console. Hook into DebugOutputPanel or document that commands are manual-invocation only.

findings.issue: SimulationStep patch overhead on every frame
findings.description: Postfix fires every frame even though work happens only every 60-64 frames. Use Harmony [HarmonyPatch] attribute with custom condition or move frame-gating to a Prefix that returns false to skip the original method when no work is needed (though Postfix can't be skipped this way — consider a Transpiler or accept the overhead).

Overwrites TM:PE buffer references without verifying the game buffer hasn't been replaced since last sync. Cache System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(liveBuffer) and compare before syncing to detect buffer replacements.
